name: Chthonic-Hollow
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in magnetic pole anomalies. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
The colonists of the buried megastructure kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
